columns.description: Number of columns in Bootstrap's grid system (12). Provides flexible layout options with divisible column counts.

gutter-width.description: Default gutter width between grid columns (1.5rem = 24px). Horizontal padding creating space between columns.

row-columns.description: Maximum number of columns for .row-cols-* classes (6). Sets the limit for auto-layout row columns.

0.description: No gutter spacing (0). Removes all spacing between columns with .g-0 class.

1.description: Extra small gutter spacing (0.25rem = 4px). Minimal spacing for tightly packed layouts.

2.description: Small gutter spacing (0.5rem = 8px). Compact spacing between columns.

3.description: Medium gutter spacing (1rem = 16px). Standard spacing for moderate column separation.

4.description: Default gutter spacing (1.5rem = 24px). Bootstrap's standard gutter width matching $grid-gutter-width.

5.description: Large gutter spacing (3rem = 48px). Wide spacing for prominent column separation.
